energy.direction: Loss on Strait reopening / energy risk-premium reversal; possible benefit on escalation.
energy.disclosure: Broad Commodity Index is attributed at full market value although only part is energy; issuer sensitivities and shock sizes are not calibrated.

shipping.direction: Loss on reopening if exceptional freight premiums unwind; escalation can also disrupt operations.
shipping.disclosure: Qualitative exposure direction, not a forecast; business and freight-rate effects can differ.

defence.direction: Potential loss on de-escalation / risk-premium reversal.
defence.disclosure: Qualitative sector proxy; not a calibrated price shock.

gold.direction: Loss on gold-price reversal; escalation may support safe-haven demand.
gold.disclosure: Gold-linked note is counted at full market value for screening despite 70% participation and maturity protection.

inflation_linked.direction: Inflation protection may benefit, but rising real yields can reduce market value.
inflation_linked.disclosure: Direction is mixed without real-rate and breakeven decomposition.

duration_credit.direction: Loss on rising yields / inflation escalation; lower yields may support prices.
duration_credit.disclosure: Full market value is a rate-exposure screen; durations and spreads are unavailable, so it is not a stress-loss estimate.

long_duration.direction: Loss on further yield rises, potentially amplified in long-dated bonds and perpetuals.
long_duration.disclosure: Maturity/perpetual classification is a duration proxy; call dates and effective duration are not available.

eur_rates.disclosure: EUR bond fund proxy; no duration-based stress estimate.

eur_assets.direction: USD translation may benefit from EUR appreciation; EUR-base clients have no corresponding base-currency translation gain.
eur_assets.disclosure: Currency of denomination is a proxy; hedges and underlying currency exposures are unknown.

usd_assets.direction: USD appreciation may benefit non-USD-base clients; USD weakness reverses that effect.
usd_assets.disclosure: Direction depends on exchange rates and the client's base currency; no FX forecast is made.

technology.direction: Loss on technology repricing / higher discount rates; pledged positions also reduce collateral support.
technology.disclosure: The unlisted Aranya mark is stale; quoted-market contagion need not be reflected in its reported value.

em_credit.direction: Loss on escalation / spread widening; issuer-level Gulf exposure is unknown.
em_credit.disclosure: EM sovereign fund is a broad proxy, not verified Gulf-country exposure.

private_credit.direction: Reduced liquidity on redemption stress; carrying value may not reflect exit value.
private_credit.disclosure: Quarterly gate and redemption stress are liquidity risks, not a priced loss estimate.
